domains.name: Physics
domains.description: Scientific study of matter, energy, space, time, motion, fields, and their interactions.

concepts.name: Spacetime
concepts.definition: A four-dimensional physical framework combining three spatial dimensions with time.

dimensions.notes: Spacetime combines three spatial dimensions with time and is therefore represented using a four-dimensional physical framework. The dimensional processing system will determine how this concept is computationally analyzed at each stage.

concepts.name: Motion
concepts.definition: Change in position of an object with respect to a reference frame over time.

dimensions.notes: Motion can be represented along one or more spatial coordinates and can be analyzed as a time-dependent physical process. The dimensional processing system will determine the appropriate computational representation.

concepts.name: Force
concepts.definition: An interaction that can change an object’s motion by producing acceleration or deformation.

dimensions.notes: Force can be represented as a vector with spatial components and can be analyzed as part of a time-dependent dynamical system. The dimensional processing system will determine the appropriate computational representation.
